## Workload

During the review period, Nadia Qureshi completed 761 reads over 414 hours. This represents an average of 1.8 reads per hour. The workload recorded for the period was reviewed in relation to the time available and the volume of work completed. The figures provide a clear summary of activity and indicate the level of reading undertaken during the quarter.

## Quality

A sample of 50 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement rate was 62.0 per cent. The review identified a need for continued attention to borderline background cases, where decisions may require closer consideration and consistent application of the relevant guidance. Feedback was provided on these cases to support future work and promote greater consistency in assessment.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
